phrases.japanese: 塩辛い しおからい
酸っぱい すっぱい
ありがとうございます
お手数をおかけします
遅れて申し訳ないです

phrases.english: I’m okay, really. Just tired.
phrases.japanese: だいじょうぶ、ほんとに、ちょっと疲れた。
phrases.transliteration: daijoubu, honto ni, chotto tsukareta.

phrases.english: Today feels busy, but I’ll manage.
phrases.japanese: 今日は忙しいけど、なんとかなるよ。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa isogashii kedo, nantoka naru yo.

phrases.english: Take your time, I’m not rushing.
phrases.japanese: ゆっくりでいいよ、急いでないから。
phrases.transliteration: yukkuri de ii yo, isoide nai kara.

phrases.english: Thanks, that helped a lot.
phrases.japanese: ありがとう、すごく助かったよ。
phrases.transliteration: arigatou, sugoku tasukatta yo.

phrases.english: Sorry, I forgot. My bad.
phrases.japanese: ごめん、忘れてた。ほんとに。
phrases.transliteration: gomen, wasureterta. honto ni.

phrases.english: I like watching baseball games, a lot.
phrases.japanese: 野球の試合を見るのが好きだよ。
phrases.transliteration: yakyuu no shiai o miru no ga suki dayo

phrases.english: Let’s go for a run after work, okay?
phrases.japanese: 仕事のあと走ろう、いい？
phrases.transliteration: shigoto no ato hashirou, ii?

phrases.english: I’m trying to improve my tennis serve.
phrases.japanese: テニスのサーブを上手くなりたい。
phrases.transliteration: tenisu no saabu o umaku naritai

phrases.english: That goal was amazing, honestly!
phrases.japanese: あのゴールはすごかった、まじで！
phrases.transliteration: ano gooru wa sugokatta, maji de!

phrases.english: I hit the ball too hard today.
phrases.japanese: 今日はボールを強く打ちすぎた。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa booru o tsuyoku uchisugita

phrases.english: It’s sunny today, isn’t it?
phrases.transliteration: Kyou wa hareteru ne.

phrases.english: The sky looks cloudy, though.
phrases.transliteration: Demo sora ga kumoppoi.

phrases.english: It’s raining right now, sorry.
phrases.transliteration: Ima ame ga futteru, ne.

phrases.english: The rain is light, I think.
phrases.transliteration: Ame, kekkou yowai yo.

phrases.english: Stop, it’s going to rain.
phrases.transliteration: Yamete, ame ni narisou.

phrases.english: Take one slow breath, right now.
phrases.japanese: いま、ゆっくり息を一つ。
phrases.transliteration: ima, yukkuri iki o hitotsu.

phrases.english: Let your shoulders soften, gently.
phrases.japanese: 肩の力を、やさしく抜いて。
phrases.transliteration: kata no chikara o, yasashiku nuite.

phrases.english: Feel your feet on the ground.
phrases.japanese: 足の裏を、地面に感じて。
phrases.transliteration: ashi no ura o, jimen ni kanjite.

phrases.english: Notice sounds around you, calmly.
phrases.japanese: 周りの音に、静かに気づいて。
phrases.transliteration: mawari no oto ni, shizuka ni kizuite.

phrases.english: Inhale peace, exhale tension.
phrases.japanese: 深く吸って、緊張を吐いて。
phrases.transliteration: fukaku suwatte, kinchō o haite.

phrases.english: Where is the nearest convenience store?
phrases.japanese: いちばん近いコンビニはどこですか。
phrases.transliteration: ichiban chikai konbini wa doko desu ka

phrases.english: Do you have this in a smaller size?
phrases.japanese: これ、もう少し小さいのありますか。
phrases.transliteration: kore, mou sukoshi chiisai no arimasu ka

phrases.english: Can I try this on, please?
phrases.japanese: これ、試着してもいいですか。
phrases.transliteration: kore, shichaku shite mo ii desu ka

phrases.english: How much is this? Is it on sale?
phrases.japanese: これはいくらですか、セールですか。
phrases.transliteration: kore wa ikura desu ka, se-ru desu ka

phrases.english: I’ll take it, how do I pay?
phrases.japanese: 買います、どうやって支払いますか。
phrases.transliteration: kaimasu, dou yatte shiharai masu ka

phrases.english: I breathe, then I choose better.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、いい選択をする。
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, ii sentaku o suru

phrases.english: Today, I focus on one small win.
phrases.japanese: 今日は、ひとつの小さな勝利に集中する。
phrases.transliteration: kyō wa, hitotsu no chiisana shōri ni shūchū suru

phrases.english: I forgive myself, and I move on.
phrases.japanese: 自分を許して、前に進む。
phrases.transliteration: jibun o yurusete, mae ni susumu

phrases.english: I drink water, my body feels better.
phrases.japanese: 水を飲んで、体が楽になる。
phrases.transliteration: mizu o nonde, karada ga raku ni naru

phrases.english: I write one page, every day.
phrases.transliteration: mainichi, hito pēji kaku

phrases.english: Don’t quit, just go one step.
phrases.japanese: やめないで、まずは一歩だけ。
phrases.transliteration: Yamenai de, mazu wa ippo dake.

phrases.english: Keep trying, even slowly.
phrases.japanese: ゆっくりでも、続けてみよう。
phrases.transliteration: Yukkuri demo, tsuzukete miyou.

phrases.english: I’ll try again, no matter what.
phrases.japanese: 何があっても、また挑戦する。
phrases.transliteration: Nani ga atte mo, mata chōsen suru.

phrases.english: Small progress is still progress.
phrases.japanese: 小さくても、進んでいるよ。
phrases.transliteration: Chiisakute mo, sunde iru yo.

phrases.english: Breathe, and start again.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、また始めよう。
phrases.transliteration: Shinkokyū shite, mata hajimeyou.

phrases.english: I’ll wait, one moment, okay?
phrases.japanese: 待ってて、ね、ちょっとだけ。
phrases.transliteration: matte te, ne, chotto dake.

phrases.english: Please wait a little, I’m almost ready.
phrases.japanese: もう少し待って、すぐ行くから。
phrases.transliteration: mō sukoshi matte, sugu iku kara.

phrases.english: No rush, take your time.
phrases.japanese: 急がなくていいよ、ゆっくりで。
phrases.transliteration: isoganakute ii yo, yukkuri de.

phrases.english: It’s okay, we’ll try again later.
phrases.japanese: 大丈夫、またあとでやろう。
phrases.transliteration: daijōbu, mata ato de yarō.

phrases.english: Just breathe, everything will work out.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、きっとうまくいくよ。
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, kitto umaku iku yo.

phrases.english: You’ve got this, just keep going.
phrases.japanese: 大丈夫、ただ進み続けてね。
phrases.transliteration: Daijōbu, tada susumi tsudzukete ne.

phrases.english: Small steps today, big change tomorrow.
phrases.japanese: 今日の小さな一歩が、明日の大きな変化。
phrases.transliteration: Kyō no chiisana ippo ga, ashita no ōkina henka.

phrases.english: Breathe, then try again.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、それからもう一回。
phrases.transliteration: Shin kokyū shite, soredkara mō ikkai.

phrases.english: Even mistakes are part of learning.
phrases.japanese: 失敗も、学びの一部だよ。
phrases.transliteration: Shippai mo, manabi no ichibu da yo.

phrases.english: Show up, even if you’re tired.
phrases.japanese: 疲れてても、行ってみよう。
phrases.transliteration: Tsukarete temo, itte miyō.

phrases.english: I checked my bank balance today, just now.
phrases.japanese: さっき口座残高を確認したよ。
phrases.transliteration: sakki kōza zandaka o kakunin shita yo.

phrases.english: How much is the monthly fee, exactly?
phrases.japanese: 月額料金はいくらですか、正確に。
phrases.transliteration: getsugaku ryōkin wa ikura desu ka, seikaku ni.

phrases.english: I transferred money to my savings.
phrases.japanese: 貯金にお金を振り込んだよ。
phrases.transliteration: chokin ni okane o furikonde ita yo.

phrases.english: Please cancel my subscription, I beg you.
phrases.japanese: サブスクを解約して,お願いします。
phrases.transliteration: sabusuku o kaik yaku shite, onega i shimasu.

phrases.english: My card payment went through smoothly.
phrases.japanese: カード決済、すんなり通ったよ。
phrases.transliteration: kādo kessai, sun'nari totta yo.

phrases.english: You’ve got this, keep going.
phrases.transliteration: daijōbu, tsuzukete ne

phrases.english: Nice work, that’s a win.
phrases.transliteration: ii ne, katta yo

phrases.english: Great job, you nailed it!
phrases.japanese: すごい、うまくできたね。
phrases.transliteration: sugoi, umaku dekita ne

phrases.english: I’m proud of you, seriously.
phrases.japanese: 本当にすごいね、誇りだよ。
phrases.transliteration: hontō ni sugoi ne, hokori da yo

phrases.english: Take a breath, you can do it.
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyū shite, dekiru yo

phrases.english: I’m counting to ten, now.
phrases.japanese: いま十まで数えてるよ。
phrases.transliteration: ima juu made kazoeteru yo

phrases.english: Give me three, please.
phrases.transliteration: mittsu kudasai

phrases.english: We need five more minutes.
phrases.transliteration: ato go-fun hitsuyou da yo

phrases.english: My phone is number seven.
phrases.transliteration: watashi no denwa wa nana-ban da yo

phrases.english: Wait, it’s 12 o’clock.
phrases.transliteration: matte, juu-ni-ji da yo

phrases.english: Happy holidays, have a great break.
phrases.japanese: 楽しいホリデーを、いい休暇を。
phrases.transliteration: Tanoshii horidē o, ii kyūka o.

phrases.english: Merry Christmas, I hope you’re warm.
phrases.japanese: メリークリスマス、あったかく過ごしてね。
phrases.transliteration: Merii kurisumasu, attakaku sugoshite ne.

phrases.english: Season’s greetings, let’s meet soon.
phrases.japanese: ごきげんよう、また近いうちにね。
phrases.transliteration: Gokigenyō, mata chikai uchi ni ne.

phrases.english: Happy New Year, wishing you health.
phrases.japanese: 新年おめでとう、健康でいてね。
phrases.transliteration: Shinnen omedetō, kenkō de ite ne.

phrases.english: Enjoy the holidays, take care.
phrases.japanese: ホリデーを楽しんでね、気をつけて。
phrases.transliteration: Horidē o tanoshinde ne, ki o tsukete.

phrases.english: Help me, please. I need assistance.
phrases.japanese: 助けてください、助けが必要です。
phrases.transliteration: tasukete kudasai, tasuke ga hitsuyō desu.

phrases.english: Stop! Somebody call an ambulance now!
phrases.japanese: 止まって！誰か、今すぐ救急車を呼んで！
phrases.transliteration: tomatte! dareka, ima sugu kyūkyūsha o yonde!

phrases.english: I’m lost. Please help me find home.
phrases.japanese: 迷子です、家まで案内してください。
phrases.transliteration: maigo desu, ie made annai shite kudasai.

phrases.english: Is everyone okay? Any injuries?
phrases.japanese: みんな大丈夫？けがはありますか。
phrases.transliteration: min’na daijōbu? kega wa arimasu ka.

phrases.english: My chest hurts. Please call a doctor.
phrases.japanese: 胸が痛いです、医者を呼んでください。
phrases.transliteration: mune ga itai desu, iasha o yonde kudasai.

phrases.english: I feel happy today, so easy.
phrases.japanese: 今日はすごく幸せ、気持ちが軽い。
phrases.transliteration: Kyou wa sugoku shiawase, kimochi ga karui.

phrases.english: Smile, things will work out.
phrases.japanese: にこっとして、きっとうまくいくよ。
phrases.transliteration: Niko tto shite, kitto umaku iku yo.

phrases.english: Grateful for this peaceful moment, really.
phrases.japanese: この穏やかな時間に感謝してる。
phrases.transliteration: Kono odayakana jikan ni kansha shiteru.

phrases.english: My heart is warm right now.
phrases.transliteration: Ima, kokoro ga attakai.

phrases.english: I’m lucky to have you, truly.
phrases.japanese: あなたがいてくれて、ほんとに幸せ。
phrases.transliteration: Anata ga ite kurete, honto ni shiawase.

phrases.english: Thanks for being my friend, always.
phrases.japanese: いつも友だちでいてくれてありがとう。
phrases.transliteration: Itsumo tomodachi de ite kurete arigatou.

phrases.english: I’m lucky to have you.
phrases.japanese: あなたに出会えてよかった。
phrases.transliteration: Anata ni deaete yokatta.

phrases.english: Let’s hang out this weekend.
phrases.transliteration: Kongeshumatsu, aou ne.

phrases.english: You can always count on me.
phrases.japanese: いつでも私を頼ってね。
phrases.transliteration: Itsudemo watashi o tayotte ne.

phrases.english: Your smile makes me happy.
phrases.japanese: あなたの笑顔に元気もらうよ。
phrases.transliteration: Anata no egao ni genki mora u yo.

phrases.english: Where is the nearest train station?
phrases.japanese: いちばん近い駅はどこですか。
phrases.transliteration: ichiban chikai eki wa doko desu ka

phrases.english: I need a ticket to Shinjuku.
phrases.japanese: 新宿までの切符をください。
phrases.transliteration: Shinjuku made no kippu o kudasai

phrases.english: How much is this, please?
phrases.transliteration: kore wa ikura desu ka

phrases.english: Is there a restroom nearby?
phrases.japanese: 近くにトイレはありますか。
phrases.transliteration: chikaku ni toire wa arimasu ka

phrases.english: Do you accept credit cards?
phrases.japanese: クレジットカードは使えますか。
phrases.transliteration: kurejitto kaado wa tsukaemasu ka

phrases.english: Thank you, you made my day.
phrases.japanese: ありがとう、うれしかったよ。
phrases.transliteration: arigatō, ureshikatta yo

phrases.english: Sorry, I didn’t mean to bother you.
phrases.japanese: ごめんね、迷惑をかけたくなかった。
phrases.transliteration: gomen ne, meiwaku o kaketakunakatta

phrases.english: Please take your time, no rush.
phrases.japanese: ゆっくりで大丈夫だよ。急がなくていい。
phrases.transliteration: yukkuri de daijōbu da yo. isoganakute ii

phrases.english: That was kind of you.
phrases.japanese: やさしいね。ありがとう。
phrases.transliteration: yasashii ne. arigatō

phrases.english: You’re doing great, keep going!
phrases.japanese: いい感じだよ。がんばって。
phrases.transliteration: ii kanji da yo. ganbatte

phrases.english: What time is it now, please?
phrases.transliteration: Ima, nanji desu ka?

phrases.english: It's 7 o'clock exactly, right?
phrases.transliteration: Choudo shichi-ji da yo ne?

phrases.english: My train leaves at 8.
phrases.transliteration: Densha wa hachiji ni demasu.

phrases.english: I’ll meet you at 5.
phrases.transliteration: Go-ji ni aou.

phrases.english: Sorry, I’m late, again!
phrases.transliteration: Gomen, mata okureta!

phrases.english: I’m heading to the office now, okay?
phrases.japanese: いま会社に向かっています、いいですか。
phrases.transliteration: ima kaisha ni mukatte imasu, ii desu ka.

phrases.english: Can you send me that file, please?
phrases.japanese: そのファイル送ってもらえますか、お願いします。
phrases.transliteration: sono fairu okutte moraemasu ka, onegaishimasu.

phrases.english: I’ll be late today, sorry.
phrases.japanese: 今日は遅れます、ごめんなさい。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa okuremasu, gomennasai.

phrases.english: Let’s wrap it up quickly, please.
phrases.japanese: 早めに終わらせましょう、お願いします。
phrases.transliteration: hayame ni owarasemashou, onegaishimasu.

phrases.english: Please check the schedule one more time.
phrases.japanese: 予定をもう一度確認してください。
phrases.transliteration: yotei o mou ichido kakunin shite kudasai.

phrases.english: I wake up, then I check my phone.
phrases.japanese: 起きたら、まずスマホを見る。
phrases.transliteration: okitara, mā sumaho o miru.

phrases.english: I brush my teeth, slowly and carefully.
phrases.japanese: 歯を磨く、ゆっくり丁寧に。
phrases.transliteration: ha o miru, yukkuri teinei ni.

phrases.english: I wash my face with cool water.
phrases.transliteration: tsumetai mizu de kao o arau.

phrases.english: I take a quick shower before work.
phrases.japanese: 仕事前に、さっとシャワーを浴びる。
phrases.transliteration: shigoto mae ni, satto shawā o abiru.

phrases.english: I get dressed, and head out.
phrases.transliteration: fuku o kite, soto ni deru.

phrases.english: I can do this, step by step.
phrases.japanese: できるよ、ひとつずつ進もう。
phrases.transliteration: dekiru yo, hitotsu zutsu susumou.

phrases.english: Hey, don’t back down today.
phrases.japanese: ねえ、今日は引かないで。
phrases.transliteration: nee, kyou wa hika naide.

phrases.english: Even if I’m scared, I’ll try.
phrases.transliteration: kowakute mo, yattemiru.

phrases.english: Take a breath, then speak up.
phrases.japanese: 深呼吸して、思い切って言おう。
phrases.transliteration: shinkokyuu shite, omoikitte iou.

phrases.english: I’m nervous, but I’m going anyway.
phrases.transliteration: kinchou suru kedo, iku yo.

phrases.english: Look, a cat is napping.
phrases.japanese: 見て、猫が昼寝してるよ。
phrases.transliteration: Mite, neko ga hirune shiteru yo.

phrases.english: My dog wants to go outside.
phrases.japanese: うちの犬が外に出たがってる。
phrases.transliteration: Uchi no inu ga soto ni detagatтeру.

phrases.english: That bird sounds so cheerful.
phrases.japanese: あの鳥、すごく楽しそうな鳴き声だね。
phrases.transliteration: Ano tori, sugoku tanoshisou na nakigoe da ne.

phrases.english: The fish is swimming near the rocks.
phrases.japanese: 魚が岩のそばを泳いでるよ。
phrases.transliteration: Sakana ga iwa no soba o oyoideru yo.

phrases.english: A rabbit hopped into the garden.
phrases.japanese: うさぎが庭にぴょんと入ってきた。
phrases.transliteration: Usagi ga niwa ni pyon to haitte kita.

phrases.english: Hi, do you have a table for two?
phrases.japanese: すみません、2人席はありますか？
phrases.transliteration: sumimasen, futari seki wa arimasu ka?

phrases.english: We're ready to order now, please.
phrases.japanese: 注文してもいいですか。
phrases.transliteration: chūmon shite mo ii desu ka?

phrases.english: Can I see the menu, please?
phrases.japanese: メニューを見せてもらえますか？
phrases.transliteration: menyū o misete moraemasu ka?

phrases.english: Do you have vegetarian options?
phrases.japanese: ベジタリアンのメニューはありますか？
phrases.transliteration: bejitarian no menyū wa arimasu ka?

phrases.english: No spicy food for me, please.
phrases.japanese: 辛いのはなしでお願いします。
phrases.transliteration: karai no wa nashi de onegaishimasu.

phrases.english: Breathe in, and soften your shoulders.
phrases.japanese: 息を吸って、肩の力を抜いてね。
phrases.transliteration: iki o sutte, kata no chikara o nuite ne

phrases.english: Right now, just let it go.
phrases.transliteration: ima wa, tada tebanasou

phrases.english: I’m here, breathing slowly, calmly.
phrases.japanese: 私はここにいて、ゆっくり呼吸する。
phrases.transliteration: watashi wa koko ni ite, yukkuri kokyuu suru

phrases.english: It’s okay, everything will work out.
phrases.japanese: 大丈夫、きっとうまくいくよ。
phrases.transliteration: daijoubu, kitto umaku iku yo

phrases.english: Smile, even if you feel tense.
phrases.japanese: 緊張してても、笑ってみて。
phrases.transliteration: kinchou shitemo, wara te mite

phrases.english: I feel happy right now,
phrases.japanese: いま、うれしい気持ちです。
phrases.transliteration: ima, ureshii kimochi desu.

phrases.english: I'm feeling calm,
phrases.transliteration: ochitsuiteimasu.

phrases.english: I feel nervous today,
phrases.japanese: 今日は緊張しています。
phrases.transliteration: kyou wa kinchou shiteimasu.

phrases.english: I'm a little worried,
phrases.transliteration: sukoshi shinpai desu.

phrases.english: I feel excited,
phrases.transliteration: waku waku shiteimasu.

phrases.english: I’m trying my best, today too.
phrases.japanese: きょうも、できるだけ頑張るよ。
phrases.transliteration: kyou mo, dekiru dake ganbaru yo

phrases.english: Sorry, I’ll be a little late.
phrases.japanese: ごめんね、少し遅れるよ。
phrases.transliteration: gomen ne, sukoshi okureru yo

phrases.english: Thanks for waiting, I appreciate it.
phrases.japanese: 待ってくれてありがとう、助かるよ。
phrases.transliteration: matte kurete arigatou, tasukaru yo

phrases.english: I’m hungry, I want something quick.
phrases.japanese: お腹すいた、早く食べたい。
phrases.transliteration: onaka suita, hayaku tabetai

phrases.english: Let’s go together, it’s easier.
phrases.transliteration: issho ni ikou, rakuda yo

phrases.english: Mom, can you call me later?
phrases.japanese: お母さん、あとで電話してね。
phrases.transliteration: Okaasan, ato de denwa shite ne.

phrases.english: Dad, I’m home now.
phrases.transliteration: Otōsan, tadaima.

phrases.english: Can I borrow your phone, Mom?
phrases.japanese: お母さん、その電話借りていい？
phrases.transliteration: Okaasan, sono denwa karite ii?

phrases.english: Dad, I need help with homework.
phrases.japanese: お父さん、宿題手伝って。
phrases.transliteration: Otōsan, shukudai tetsudatte.

phrases.english: My older sister is really kind.
phrases.transliteration: Ane wa sugoku yasashii.

phrases.english: When you enter, say hello first.
phrases.japanese: 入ったら、まずこんにちはと言ってね。
phrases.transliteration: haittara, mazu konnichiwa tte ne

phrases.english: Shoes off, please, at the entrance.
phrases.japanese: 玄関で靴を脱いでください。
phrases.transliteration: genkan de kutsu o nuide kudasai

phrases.english: We eat quietly on the train.
phrases.japanese: 電車では静かに食べます。
phrases.transliteration: densha dewa shizuka ni tabemasu

phrases.english: Please keep your voice low.
phrases.transliteration: koe wa chiisame ni shite ne

phrases.english: Let's line up, one by one.
phrases.transliteration: junban ni narabimashou

phrases.english: It’s hot today, isn’t it?
phrases.transliteration: Kyou wa atsui desu ne.

phrases.english: The wind is getting stronger, wow.
phrases.japanese: 風が強くなってきたね。
phrases.transliteration: Kaze ga tsuyoku natte kita ne.

phrases.english: Clouds are moving fast overhead.
phrases.japanese: 上の雲がすごく流れてるよ。
phrases.transliteration: Ue no kumo ga sugoku nagare teru yo.

phrases.english: I think it will snow tonight.
phrases.japanese: 今夜、雪が降りそうだよ。
phrases.transliteration: Kon'ya, yuki ga furi-sou da yo.

phrases.english: It’s getting colder, be careful.
phrases.japanese: だんだん寒くなってきたよ。
phrases.transliteration: Dandan samuku natte kita yo.

phrases.english: Go straight, then turn left.
phrases.japanese: まっすぐ行って、左に曲がってください。
phrases.transliteration: massugu itte, hidari ni magatte kudasai.

phrases.english: Turn right at the next corner.
phrases.japanese: 次の角を右に曲がってください。
phrases.transliteration: tsugi no kado o migi ni magatte kudasai.

phrases.english: Walk two blocks, then stop.
phrases.japanese: 二つ先まで歩いて、そこで止まって。
phrases.transliteration: futatsu saki made aruite, soko de tomatte.

phrases.english: The station is down the street.
phrases.transliteration: eki wa dori no saki desu.

phrases.english: Please follow me, it's this way.
phrases.japanese: こっちです、私についてきてください。
phrases.transliteration: kocchi desu, watashi ni tsuite kite kudasai.

phrases.english: My head hurts, really bad today.
phrases.japanese: 頭が痛い、今日は本当にひどい。
phrases.transliteration: Atama ga itai, kyou wa hontou ni hidoi.

phrases.english: I bumped my shoulder on the door.
phrases.transliteration: Doa ni kata o butsuketa.

phrases.english: My back feels stiff right now.
phrases.japanese: 今、背中がこわばってる。
phrases.transliteration: Ima, senaka ga kowa batteru.

phrases.english: Wash your hands, please.
phrases.transliteration: Te o aratte kudasai.

phrases.english: My stomach is upset, sorry.
phrases.japanese: お腹が気持ち悪い、ごめんね。
phrases.transliteration: O-naka ga kimochi warui, gomen ne.

phrases.english: I can’t log in right now.
phrases.japanese: いまログインできません。
phrases.transliteration: ima roguin dekimasen

phrases.english: My phone is running out of battery.
phrases.japanese: スマホの電池がもう少ない。
phrases.transliteration: sumaho no denchi ga mou sukunai

phrases.english: The Wi‑Fi keeps disconnecting.
phrases.transliteration: Wi-Fi ga sugu kireru

phrases.english: Please connect the cable firmly.
phrases.japanese: ケーブルをしっかり挿して。
phrases.transliteration: ke-buru o shikkari sashtte

phrases.english: Can you send that link again?
phrases.japanese: そのリンク、もう一度送って。
phrases.transliteration: sono rinku, mou ichido okutte

phrases.english: I play basketball on weekends.
phrases.japanese: 週末にバスケをします。
phrases.transliteration: shuumatsu ni basuke o shimasu

phrases.english: I’m learning how to swim better.
phrases.japanese: 泳ぎをもっと上手になりたいです。
phrases.transliteration: oyogi o motto joozu ni naritai desu

phrases.english: My knee hurts after soccer.
phrases.japanese: サッカーのあと膝が痛い。
phrases.transliteration: sakkaa no ato hiza ga itai

phrases.english: We have practice at six.
phrases.transliteration: renshuu wa roku-ji desu

phrases.english: That referee call shocked me.
phrases.japanese: あの審判の判定に驚いた。
phrases.transliteration: ano shinpan no hantei ni odoroita

phrases.english: I need clean socks, today.
phrases.japanese: きれいな靴下が必要です、今日。
phrases.transliteration: kirei na kutsushita ga hitsuyō desu, kyō.

phrases.english: Where are my shoes, please?
phrases.japanese: 私の靴はどこですか、お願いします。
phrases.transliteration: watashi no kutsu wa doko desu ka, onegaishimasu.

phrases.english: This jacket fits me well.
phrases.japanese: このジャケット、私にぴったりです。
phrases.transliteration: kono jaketto, watashi ni pitta-ri desu.

phrases.english: I spilled coffee on my shirt.
phrases.japanese: シャツにコーヒーをこぼしました。
phrases.transliteration: shatsu ni kōhī o koboshimashita.

phrases.english: Do you have this in black?
phrases.transliteration: kore, kuro mo arimasu ka.

phrases.english: Thank you for helping me today, really.
phrases.japanese: 今日助けてくれて、本当にありがとう。
phrases.transliteration: Kyou tasukete kurete, hontou ni arigatou.

phrases.english: I really appreciate your kindness, thank you.
phrases.japanese: 親切にしてくれて、ありがとう。
phrases.transliteration: Shinsetsu ni shite kurete, arigatou.

phrases.english: Thanks for listening, it means a lot.
phrases.japanese: 聞いてくれて、すごく嬉しい。
phrases.transliteration: Kikite kurete, sugoku ureshii.

phrases.english: Thanks for your time, I’m grateful.
phrases.japanese: 時間をくれてありがとう、とても助かりました。
phrases.transliteration: Jikan o kurete arigatou, totemo tasukarimashita.

phrases.english: Thank you, I feel better now.
phrases.japanese: ありがとう、今は気持ちが楽だよ。
phrases.transliteration: Arigatou, ima wa kimochi ga rakuda yo.

phrases.english: My boyfriend is really kind, today.
phrases.japanese: うちの彼氏はすごく優しい、今日。
phrases.transliteration: uchi no kareshi wa sugoku yasashii, kyou.

phrases.english: My girlfriend texted me, late.
phrases.japanese: 彼女が遅くにメールしてくれた。
phrases.transliteration: kanojo ga osoku ni meeru shite kureta.

phrases.english: We argue, but we make up.
phrases.japanese: 私たちは言い合うけど、仲直りする。
phrases.transliteration: watashitachi wa ii a u kedo, naka naori suru.

phrases.english: I miss you so much, right now.
phrases.transliteration: ima, sugoku aitai.

phrases.english: I love you, and I mean it.
phrases.japanese: 愛してる、ちゃんと本気だよ。
phrases.transliteration: aishiteru, chanto honki da yo.
